name: Tatsumi
source:
Shou's childhood friend and best friend, and a member of the art club.

He likes to draw, but he has no talent. On top of that, he draws nothing but creepy pictures, so no one acknowledges him.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/bl/work/=/product_id/RJ322759.html]DLsite[/url]]
